target.statement: MVP-LM (Swin-B, Phi-1.5) reaches 83.6 cIoU on RefCOCO val for referring expression segmentation, the paper's headline sentence-based RES result.

compute.basis: The metric comes only from the fully trained MVP-LM, which requires LLaVA-style two-stage training (Stage 2: 80k iters at batch 64, 1024x1024, joint COCO-Panoptic + RefCOCO + O365 + GoldG across ~2.7M samples) with a VLLM, Swin-B and multi-granularity decoder, so no number can be obtained without a multi-GPU-scale training run; on an 8-core/16 GB CPU laptop this would never finish in the allotted hours.

blockers: Requires full multi-dataset joint training (COCO-Panoptic, RefCOCO, O365 1.7M, GoldG 770K) at 1024x1024 for 80k iterations, far beyond a single laptop CPU
O365 + GoldG + CC3M datasets total hundreds of GB of images and annotations
No released checkpoints given; code promised only as 'will be available', so configs/weights/reproduction details are unverified
Training Phi-1.5 + Swin-B + OpenSeeD-style decoder realistically needs multiple high-VRAM GPUs
title: Advancing Visual Large Language Model for Multi-granular Versatile Perception
